```{r not run Cause-specific Cox}

colnames(imp3.12y)

colnames(data3)

data3$datedeath


#---create id first----

data3$id <- seq_len(nrow(data3))

imp3.12y <- imp3.12y %>%
  left_join(data3 %>% select(id, datedeath), by = "id")

data.comp10<-imp3.12y

#---if date of death is bigger than t, then it should be censor instead of dead---

data.comp10$death.beforet<-as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$t), format="%Y-%m-%d")-
                           as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$datedeath), format="%Y-%m-%d")

data.comp10$death.beforet<-as.numeric(data.comp10$death.beforet)

data.comp10$dead <- ifelse(data.comp10$death.beforet < 0, 0, 2)


#---For those dead=2, put them into cens, if cens=0----

data.comp10$cens.ins<-data.comp10$cens


data.comp10$cens[data.comp10$dead == 2 & data.comp10$cens == 0] <- 2

```

```{r cut it 10 years}


#----need to cut it 10 years----


data.comp10$new.t<-as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$end.date ), format="%Y-%m-%d")-
                as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$datevisitbl), format="%Y-%m-%d")



data.comp10$new.t<-as.numeric(data.comp10$new.t)

data.comp10$new.year<-data.comp10$new.t/365.25


#--------Change censor 10y and 4.8y---------

#--create 2 event----

data.comp10$event <- 0

data.comp10$event[!is.na(data.comp10$dateinstitution)] <- 1

data.comp10$event[is.na(data.comp10$dateinstitution) & !is.na(data.comp10$datedeath)] <- 2

check.event<-data.comp10%>%
  select(id,clus,dateinstitution,datedeath,event)

#Other study
data.comp10$event[data.comp10$new.year>10]<-0 #0=right censored, 1=event 
data.comp10$new.year[data.comp10$new.year>10]<-10 #If follow-up time>10 then change to 10 year



```

```{r NOT RUN create competing risk} 

#---if date of death is bigger than end.date, then it should be censor instead of dead---

data.comp10$death.beforet<-as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$end.date), format="%Y-%m-%d")-
                           as.Date(as.character(data.comp10$datedeath), format="%Y-%m-%d")

data.comp10$death.beforet<-as.numeric(data.comp10$death.beforet)

data.comp10$dead <- ifelse(data.comp10$death.beforet < 0, 0, 2)


#---For those dead=2, put them into cens, if cens=0----

data.comp10$cens.ins<-data.comp10$cens


data.comp10$cens[data.comp10$dead == 2 & data.comp10$cens == 0] <- 2

```

```{r competing risk}


library(rstpm2)

#data.comp10$new.year


# ── 1. Fit cause-specific models ──────────────────────────────────────────────

data.comp10$ev1 <- as.integer(data.comp10$event == 1)
data.comp10$ev2 <- as.integer(data.comp10$event == 2)

# Cause 1: Institutionalisation (cens == 1), treating death as censored
fit_inst <- stpm2(
  Surv(new.year, ev1) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal+clus,
  data  = data.comp10,
  df    = 1,        # df=1 with scale="odds" ≈ your k=0 flexsurvspline model
  scale = "odds"
)

# Cause 2: Death (cens == 2), treating institutionalisation as censored
fit_death <- stpm2(
  Surv(new.year, ev2) ~ age10 + sex + mdsupdrs3.10 + hybl + mmsebltotal+clus,
  data  = data.comp10,
  df    = 1,
  scale = "odds"
)




```





```{r plot to compare}


# ── 2. Function to compute 10-year CIF for one patient ────────────────────────
tgrid <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.1)

get_cif_10y <- function(i, data, fit1, fit2, tgrid) {
  nd <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]
  
  nd_long            <- nd[rep(1, length(tgrid)), ]
  nd_long$new.year   <- tgrid   # <-- use the actual time variable name
  rownames(nd_long)  <- NULL
  
  H1 <- predict(fit1, newdata = nd_long, type = "cumhaz")
  H2 <- predict(fit2, newdata = nd_long, type = "cumhaz")
  
  S      <- exp(-(H1 + H2))
  dH1    <- diff(c(0, H1))
  S_left <- c(1, S[-length(S)])
  cif1   <- cumsum(S_left * dH1)
  
  return(tail(cif1, 1))
}

# ── 3. Apply to all patients ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
data.comp10$pred_10y_cif <- sapply(
  seq_len(nrow(data.comp10)),
  get_cif_10y,
  data  = data.comp10,
  fit1  = fit_inst,
  fit2  = fit_death,
  tgrid = tgrid
)

# ── 4. Naive 10-year failure probability (no competing risk adjustment) ────────
nd_10y        <- data.comp10
nd_10y$new.year   <- 10

data.comp10$pred_10y_nocr <- predict(
  fit_inst,
  newdata = nd_10y,
  type    = "fail"
)

# ── 5. Sanity check: CIF should always be <= naive probability ─────────────────
stopifnot(all(data.comp10$pred_10y_cif <= data.comp10$pred_10y_nocr + 1e-6))

# ── 6. Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot(
  data.comp10$pred_10y_nocr,
  data.comp10$pred_10y_cif,
  xlab = "Predicted risk (cause-specific, no competing risk)",
  ylab = "Predicted CIF (competing risks adjusted)",
  main = "Impact of competing risks on 10-year institutionalisation risk",
  pch  = 16,
  col  = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.5),
  xlim = c(0, 1),
  ylim = c(0, 1)
)







```
